settings.name: DISABLE_DEFAULT_SERVER
settings.description: **Default Server:** Set to `yes` to disable the default server when no hostname matches the request.

settings.name: DISABLE_DEFAULT_SERVER_STRICT_SNI
settings.description: **Strict SNI:** When set to `yes`, requires SNI for HTTPS connections and rejects connections without valid SNI.

settings.name: DENY_HTTP_STATUS
settings.description: **Deny HTTP Status:** HTTP status code to send when request is denied (403 or 444). Code 444 closes the connection.

settings.name: ALLOWED_METHODS
settings.description: **HTTP Methods:** List of HTTP methods that are allowed, separated by pipe characters. Custom uppercase methods may contain underscores and dashes.

settings.name: MAX_CLIENT_SIZE
settings.description: **Maximum Request Size:** The maximum allowed size for client request bodies (e.g., file uploads).

settings.name: MAX_HEADERS
settings.description: **Maximum Headers:** Maximum number of header lines per request. Requests exceeding this limit are rejected with `400 Bad Request`.

settings.name: LISTEN_HTTP
settings.description: **HTTP Listen:** Respond to (insecure) HTTP requests when set to `yes`. Can also be disabled by leaving `HTTP_PORT` empty.

settings.name: HTTP2
settings.description: **HTTP2:** Support HTTP2 protocol when HTTPS is enabled.

settings.name: HTTP3
settings.description: **HTTP3:** Support HTTP3 protocol when HTTPS is enabled.

settings.name: HTTP3_ALT_SVC_PORT
settings.description: **HTTP3 Alt-Svc Port:** Port to use in the Alt-Svc header for HTTP3.

settings.name: SERVE_FILES
settings.description: **Serve Files:** When set to `yes`, BunkerWeb will serve static files from the configured root folder.

settings.name: ROOT_FOLDER
settings.description: **Root Folder:** The directory from which to serve static files. Empty means use the default location.

settings.name: SEND_ANONYMOUS_REPORT
settings.description: **Anonymous Reports:** Send anonymous usage reports to BunkerWeb maintainers.

settings.name: EXTERNAL_PLUGIN_URLS
settings.description: **External Plugins:** URLs for external plugins to download (space-separated).

settings.name: USE_OPEN_FILE_CACHE
settings.description: **Enable Cache:** Enable caching of file descriptors and metadata to improve performance.

settings.name: OPEN_FILE_CACHE
settings.description: **Cache Configuration:** Configure the open file cache (e.g., maximum entries and inactive timeout).

settings.name: OPEN_FILE_CACHE_ERRORS
settings.description: **Cache Errors:** Cache file descriptor lookup errors as well as successful lookups.

settings.name: OPEN_FILE_CACHE_MIN_USES
settings.description: **Minimum Uses:** Minimum number of accesses during the inactive period for a file to remain cached.

settings.name: OPEN_FILE_CACHE_VALID
settings.description: **Cache Validity:** Time after which cached elements are revalidated.
